purpose: Public participant-facing schedule image configuration for the event website. The schedule source images are already clear, so the website should display the images directly instead of rebuilding the schedule as structured timeline data.

renderingGuidance.instruction: Render the schedule source images directly as the main schedule content.
renderingGuidance.styleIntent: Preserve the original poster-style schedule design, including warm cream backgrounds, orange/brown accents, icon labels, and illustrated music-event tone.
imageBehavior: Show each image at full container width on mobile.
Allow users to tap an image to view it larger in a lightbox / modal.
The enlarged view must have a clear close button and must be usable on mobile.
Use concise text captions or notes around the image only when useful.
avoid: Rebuilding the schedule as a separate timeline UI
Transcribing the schedule image into duplicated structured schedule cards
Showing staff-only preparation or teardown workflows as separate public website content
